name: MS-DOS 2.0 MORE.COM
notes: The published binary is authoritative; do not patch or rebuild it for acceptance.
MORE.ASM has IBMVER=TRUE, but this binary has no video-mode query and a 24-row limit; source and binary configurations differ.
Short reference cases exercise stdin redirection, stdout redirection, EOF and Ctrl-Z, not interactive pagination.
FunnyCOM currently treats redirection tokens as PSP command-tail text, not handle wiring.
This probe documents incompatibility, not completed M5 application acceptance.
